finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹800 Cr, EBITDA margin = 20%, Debt = ₹600 Cr, Interest rate = 8%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 10%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹160 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹48 Cr = ₹112 Cr.
New revenue = ₹720 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹144 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹96 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-16 Cr — notice how a 10% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
